description: In crates/core/src/rate_limiter.rs, call_count is initialized to 0 and the eviction check is 'call_count % EVICT_INTERVAL == 0'. On the very first call, 0 % 1024 == 0, so eviction runs over an empty HashMap on every server startup. This is cheap but misleading — the intent is 'every 1024th call after the first'. Fix: initialize call_count to 1, or change the condition to 'call_count > 0 && call_count % EVICT_INTERVAL == 0'.
title: rate_limiter: call_count starts at 0, first-ever call always triggers eviction
